secrets.name: HSOMNI9000_API_KEY
secrets.description: Shared API key authenticating Heyns1000 QS Command Center webhook requests (sent as X-API-KEY header by the sender)

secrets.name: QS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared HMAC secret the QS Command Center uses to sign webhook bodies (X-QS-Signature: sha256=...); optional — signature verification is active only when set

secrets.name: QS_COMMAND_CENTER_ENDPOINT
secrets.description: QS Command Center telemetry URL that BuildNest POSTs confirmations back to
